rows.note: Use 慢慢咁 as the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something at an unhurried pace.

example.english: We ate leisurely, with no need to hurry.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 maan6 maan2 gam3 sik6 m4 sai2 gap1

rows.note: Choose 悠閒咁 when the manner emphasizes a relaxed, carefree feeling rather than just a slow pace.

example.english: We sat leisurely by the sea, drinking tea and watching the waves.
example.traditional: 我哋悠閒咁坐喺海邊飲茶，睇住啲浪。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau4 haan4 gam3 co5 hai2 hoi2 bin1 jam2 caa4 tai2 zyu6 di1 long6
